title: Contact support and practical identifiability of spur gear microgeometry from transmission error
resource_description: Reproducibility package accompanying the current editorial manuscript. Retains the version-14 numerical evidence and 32 restricted-distance cases with 192 attempts. Version 16 integrates the supplied editorial review without new numerical experiments. Includes source code, archived records, editable manuscript construction, supplementary controls and SHA-256 manifest. The fixed-compliance observability results do not establish physical microgeometry recovery, and external amplitude discrepancy remains unresolved.
